name: Jaca (Spain)
description: Red field charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Jaca (a cross and fleurs-de-lis on red within a wreath, inscribed).
history: Municipal flag of Jaca; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
